title: Aura HUD
description: A lightweight Minecraft Java 1.21+ HUD mod that shows accurate coordinates and real-time FPS in a clean and simple display.
body:
### ABOUT

![Overview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d44739c7e655a60ff4e94e2b87ed2d415f49625f_0.webp)

Aura Cords is a fully lightweight client-side mod that displays your coordinates and FPS with a clean and colorful design. Unlike other mods that use plain white text, Aura Cords adds style with custom colors: X in red, Y in green, Z in cyan, and FPS in golden for a cleaner and easier-to-read experience. Designed with performance in mind, it stays lightweight while giving your HUD a more modern and polished look.
